cuda-substitution-2026-10-22: nixos-unstable-small + global cudaSupport means every derivation reading `enableCuda ? config.cudaSupport` gets a hash no cache publishes (CUDA is only built for full nixos-unstable). Override with `{ enableCuda = false; }` — the arg is enableCuda, NOT cudaSupport (passing cudaSupport to .override is an eval error). Applied to opencv4 (only consumer frei0r->shotcut) and peakperf (its GPU path targets compute_50, dropped in CUDA 13: 'nvcc fatal: Unsupported gpu architecture'). ncnn needs nothing (Vulkan, no cudaSupport arg). Full write-up: .opencode/context/cuda-build-strategy.md, ADR-019.
rebuild-throughput-2026-10-22: maxJobs lowered 32->4 and cores=6 in modules/nixos/base/nix.nix. At max-jobs=32 on 31 GiB the kernel OOM killer reaped Firefox renderers (oom_score_adj=200) mid-rebuild. Kill a long rebuild by process group (/tmp/rebuild.pgid) — never pkill -f, the pattern matches the killer's own command line.
